newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil Singapore restarts refinery on April 21.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Singapore restarts refinery on April 21.

text.p: Mobil Oil Singapore has restarted its main 250,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) as scheduled on Monday after regular maintenance despite earlier accidents at the refinery, industry sources said.
Mobil shut down its 280,000-bpd refinery and 500,000 tonne-per-year petrochemical complex on March 15 for maintenance and upgrading works to raise the refinery's capacity to 300,000-bpd.
The refinery was scheduled for restart on April 21-23 and there were talks last week that the start-up would be delayed due to three mishaps in late March.
One source said the refinery's smaller 50,000-bpd number 1 CDU will be restarted soon with the petrochemical complex slated for startup late this week.
Of the three incidents reported at the refinery, a gas leak at the petrochemical complex was most serious leading to two deaths and a suspension of maintenance works for two days.
